chapter: Wax Records, Broadway shows and Eddie Condon
title: Getting into Broadway pit work as the token Black player
summary: Hall tells how he got the Diamond Horseshoe job and Barefoot Boy with Cheek and High Button Shoes.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: That, that was the date that Bill Coleman was on, but I was working at the theater then so I couldn't get
off to make the dates.
How did you get into the theater?

Herman Chittison (phonetic) recommended me. "Venus on The Half Shell" I was working at the Diamond Horseshoe. Jackie Gleason was a stand up comedian then and Milton Berle, Toots Shore and Joe Dimaggio were his hecklers. And Milton Rosenstock was the conductor of the show. I can't think of the title right this minute. But he had been the conductor of "This Is The Army" with all the black performers and -- like Stump Cross, Honey Cole, those kind of people. And he got a flair for what the black performer had to offer. So, when he got this show, he wanted a half and half orchestra, half white and half black, and he posted a sign for availability at the Union and they made him take it down. And of all the blacks that he had recommended, which there were about six or eight which would be in big bands, (inaudible), Jimmy Crawford.
Yeah.
He was reduced down to me.
So, you were the token?
I was the token. "Barefoot Boy With Cheek"
But at that time, I guess there were no black players in orchestra pits (inaudible).
No, not for white shows.
Yeah, for black shows.
"Mr. Wonderful" had came about so, from Barefoot Milton Boy With Cheek, with Rosenstock, that show didn't last too
long. It was Red Buttons and Nancy Walker, and we went into "High Button Shoes."
That was --
Joe Kipness (inaudible). Phil Silvers and Joey Fay, and that lasted almost as long as three years.
Yeah.
So, I was in the theater.
So you weren't playing gigs then?
I was making some records.
But then Wax Records was going during this time?
Yeah.
